title: Defect Density — Overview
summary: Defects per thousand lines of code (or function point) — the standard quality-density measure.
body:
Defects per thousand lines of code (or function point) — the standard quality-density measure. Standard software quality metric.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Code Quality, DPMO, Static Analysis.
